tools.name: get_budget
tools.description: Read income and expense totals for one MBC budget month. Does not move money or provide a verified bank balance.

tools.name: prepare_expense
tools.description: Prepare one expense proposal and return its separate MBC approval link. A proposal does not record an expense or make a payment. amountMinor is an integer in the connected account currency’s ISO minor units (EUR 12.34 = 1234; JPY 123 = 123), using the minorUnitDigits from its budget totals. requestK

tools.name: expense_status
tools.description: Read whether the user approved a prepared expense. Only state recorded means it was booked; pending is not success.
